[Verse 1]
[F#]I'm goin'
down to the Railway Sta-
tion, gonna get a
[B]ticket to ride
Find a
[F#]big fat lady with two
or three kids and sit down
[C#]by her side
[F#]Ride 'til the sun comes up
and down around me 'bout
[B]two or three times
Smokin'
[F#]cigarettes in the last
seat
[C#]Tryin' to hide my sorrow from the
people I meet And get a-
[F#]long with it all
Go down where the
[B]people say "y'all"
Sing a
[F#]song with a friend
Change the
[C#]shape that I'm in
And get
[F#]back in the game And start
[B]playin' again
[F#]
[C#]

[Verse 2]
[F#]I'd like to stay but I
might have to go to start o-
[B]ver again
Might go
[F#]back down to Texas or might
go to somewhere that I've
[C#]never been
And
[F#]get up in the mornin' and go
out at night And I won't
[B]have to go home
Get used to
[F#]bein' alone
Change the
[C#]words to this song
And start
[F#]singin' again
[B]
[F#]
[C#]

[Break]
[F#]
[B]
[F#]
[C#]
[F#]

[Verse 3]
[F#]I'm tired of
runnin' 'round lookin' for an-
swers to questions that I
[B]already know
I could
[F#]build me a castle of me-
mories just to have some-
[C#]where to go
Count the
[F#]days and the nights that it takes
to get back in the sad-
[B]dle again
Feed the
[F#]pigeons some clay
Turn the night
[C#]into day
And start
[F#]talkin' again, when I know
[B]what to say
[F#]
[C#]

[Break]
[F#]
[B]
[F#]
[C#]

[Verse 4]
[F#]I'm goin'
down to the Greyhound Sta-
tion, gonna get a
[B]ticket to ride
Find a
[F#]big fat lady with two
or three kids and sit down
[C#]by her side
[F#]Ride 'til the sun comes up
and down around me 'bout
[B]two or three times
Smokin'
[F#]cigarettes in the last
seat
[C#]Tryin' to hide my sorrow from the
people I meet And get a-
[F#]long with it all
Go down where the
[B]people say "y'all"
Feed the
[F#]pigeons some clay
Turn the
[C#]night into day
And start
[F#]talkin' again When I know
[B]what to say
[F#]
[C#]
